qualityAssessment.reviewer: Claude Code agent (2026-10-03), manual comparison against translation-samples.json checks plus automated structure checks
qualityAssessment.notes: Same model, system prompt and user prompt in both arms (input_tokens 481 vs 482 in the shell smoke; the 1-token gap came from a trailing newline in the shell test file). All checks preserved in both arms: negation, cancellation/requestID conditions, 1.5 s / 2 retries / 4,000 characters vs bytes, `cancel()`/`requestID` verbatim with 3 lines, 3 paragraphs and all conditions in the long samples. Wording varies between repeats in both arms (sampling); one stream-warm en-long-1 repeat used plain declarative endings (-한다) and one stream-warm en-paragraph-1 repeat rendered an imperative as declarative (표시합니다) - stylistic, meaning preserved; comparable variation exists in baseline repeats. The en-long-1 stream-warm 7.6 s outlier was server-side (duration_api_ms 7,555 ms; local overhead ~11 ms).
